# National Foreign Language Resource Center (NFLRC)

> > The NFLRC at University of Hawai'i at Mānoa advances foreign language education through research, professional development, and innovative language learning resources.

The National Foreign Language Resource Center is a federally-funded center dedicated to improving less commonly taught language instruction and language pedagogy in the United States. Based at the University of Hawai'i at Mānoa and supported by the U.S. Department of Education, NFLRC develops publications, professional development modules, podcasts, and research initiatives to support language educators and learners.
